title: Unit Event — Lead With Courage and Kindness — Episode6 Facing The Same Direction

meta.Event Outline: Honami considers Mr. Shindo's question of what kind of music she aspires to, but finds herself feeling restless as she's unable to find an answer. Meanwhile, Mr. Shindo discusses Leo/need with the president of Solis Records.

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard
se_run_women_003_1
se_run_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Hona, Ichi!
I'm really sorry. Homeroom went on longer than I was expecting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's okay. Ours also just finished a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, shall we begin our discussion...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, you sound like you mean business!
You really are our leader now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: P-Please, Saki, I'm still just myself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, I printed out a few songs' worth of sheet music, so let's start by going through those...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As Luka suggested, we're going to comb through each one from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll talk about what we should be feeling during each part, as well as how we should be playing it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's start with this song...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this is the one we made for the Yoshizakis!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It came from how we knew they wouldn't be able to see each other, but wanted them to be able to move forward since they had all these wonderful memories to look back upon...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That also applies to us when we drifted apart...
I'm standing here now because I had those memories of our times together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, also...
I wrote this one in the hopes that looking back on those happy moments would help cheer them up...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, this song isn't only about creating connections between people like Hanano and her brother...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We also want them to remember the precious memories they have and feel better knowing that they'll always be with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
Which means I shouldn't play so hard during the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My desire to move people's hearts kept taking over, which ended up working against this song's theme.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That also goes for me wanting to cheer everyone up. This song isn't just about that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should be playing in a way that brings everyone's happy memories to the surface. Maybe like we're trying to gently console them...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's try doing that for the chorus.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, we'll rinse and repeat by going over how we should be playing the other parts of each song.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's do this! I think we can get through ten of these before we need to start heading over to the studio!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, ten? That sounds like way too many.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know!
But that's how excited we should be!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, we can make that our preliminary target. Anyway, let's keep going.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
I'm exhausted!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already this late?!
We only got through like half of them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't realize it would take this long to talk about a few songs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I wasn't expecting us to have so much fun discussing each one...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm really glad we did this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually talking about them gave me a much better understanding of what I think is most important, like what aspects of a song I can't budge on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's amazing how our interpretations could differ so much. You and Shiho even got into a really heated argument, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haha... Sorry about that, Shiho.
I think I got a little ahead of myself there.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not a problem.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, us butting heads like that is a good thing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, I'm not budging on certain things either, so I understand where you're coming from, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why it's important for us to sit down, talk about this stuff and reach a consensus.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Only then will we be able to start moving in the same direction and performing the way we should.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay for us to butt heads or get a little heated...
These discussions will allow us to explain what we're each feeling, reach an understanding...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And put on the best performances we possibly can in the end...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I think we need to stop here for today if we want to make our studio reservation...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally forgot!
But that also means we get to test what we just discussed!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Right.
Okay, let's hurry on over...!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Yes, we're executing just like we discussed...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We're keeping in line with the theme of this song and listening carefully to how we're each playing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (This sound...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hey, about the way we just played...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uhh... We were in perfect sync!
I thought we adjusted really well to this song's theme and our individual sounds.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Saki's right...
I don't think there was a problem with the way we played...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I feel like something's missing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: N-Now that we've had a chance to get loose, let's try playing it again!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay... Let's do that.
Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We kept practicing after that, but we never managed to really get it to sound right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Do we need to discuss things more? If so, we should try to keep that dialogue going...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Is that really all there is to it?
We seemed to do a better job of keeping in line with that song's theme and listening to what we were each doing.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I feel like we were missing something.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Wait...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This is awesome...!
It feels like they have more momentum than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is that what we were missing...? That energy...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Wait, let me get this straight...
We can't put on a good performance if we're all over the place, but we lose momentum when we try to compensate for each other.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(So, we just need to practice more?
Will that allow us to move as one while putting on more powerful performances?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Or is there another way...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (All this after saying that I'm going to help make their aspirations a reality.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I need to keep trying to come up with ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Huh? Who could be calling me at...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo...?
